alerts.text: Fable 5: permanent on Max, credits on Pro
alerts.dashboardText: Starting July 20, Claude Fable 5 is a permanent feature on Max and Team Premium plans at 50% of your weekly limits. Pro and Team Standard users move to usage credits — priced at $10/M input and $50/M output tokens — and get a one-time $100 credit to get started. Tap for details.

alerts.text: Claude Code limits stay 50% higher through Aug 19
alerts.dashboardText: Anthropic is keeping Claude Code's weekly rate limits 50% higher for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise users — now extended through August 19, 2026 at 11:59:59 PM PT. Tap for details.

Claude Opus 5 launched July 24 — near-Fable-5 intelligence at half the price, with a new low/medium/high effort toggle. It's the default model on Max and the strongest model on Pro, at $5/M input and $25/M output tokens. Tap to read more.

Claude Fable 5.1 launched September 1, with mid-conversation effort adjustment and content provenance tracking on outputs, plus 25% cheaper cache costs. Pricing stays at $10/M input and $50/M output tokens. Mythos 5.1 is limited to vetted Project Glasswing participants. Tap to read more.

alerts.text: Claude Code weekly limits change Sept 14
alerts.dashboardText: Starting Sept 14, Claude Code's weekly limits rise 25% from baseline for Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise — but since the temporary +50% boost ends the same day, you'll see about 17% less weekly capacity than you have now. 5-hour limits aren't affected. Tap for details.

alerts.text: Free plan: usage no longer shown
alerts.dashboardText: Claude's Free plan no longer shows a usage percentage. This only affects Free accounts — Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise usage tracking is unaffected.
